name: portfolio-site
description: Mars Cruz portfolio site built with React 19, Vite, Meta Astryx, and Tailwind CSS

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entries/prerender.tsx --outDir .vite-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/py.mjs scripts/build_llms.py
scripts.check: node scripts/py.mjs scripts/check_facts.py . && node scripts/py.mjs scripts/build_llms.py --check
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run check && npm run check:html && npm run check:artifacts && npm test
